title: DONNELLY, Thomas (Tom) Mount Henry: Death
textSnippet: DONNELLY, Thomas (Tom) Mount Henry: Death : Irish Times The Irish Times My Account --> Subscribe Sign In --> Family Notices Irish Times Family Notices Recent Notices Book a notice Sign in Notice Condolences DONNELLY, Thomas (Tom) Mount Henry: Death Death 3928 4 Condolences --> Published on the Irish Times website on 24th March 2023 DONNELLY, Thomas (Tom) (Mount Henry, Park, Wexford) March 7, 2023 suddenly in the UK after a brief illness. To the inexpressible grief of his wife Diana, his adored sons Thomas, Michael, and James. His devoted and much-loved sister Mary Donnelly. His wonderful grandchildren Ilya, Yuri, Pia, and India. His cherished daughters-in-law Masha and Jane. Sadly, missed by his brothers-in-law Michael and Jim Stafford and sister-in-law Patricia Stafford. His nieces Susanne, Julie, Gemma, Carol-Ann, Sarah, Diana, and Louise Stafford. His nephews Michael and George Stafford. His close friends Olive Williams, Jim and Martha Breen, Noel and Clare McSweeney, Matthew and Grainne Britton, Victoria King, and Terri Murray. His much-loved Donohoe family in Clondaw; John, Rita, Cara, Bernadette, Anne, Marie, Paula, Eamonn, Brendan and Claire. His private farewell took place
